# Third-party weapon art

Only weapon art remains from the online asset update. All maps, characters,
cattle, monsters, buildings, UI, boats and lift art use the project's original
pixel rendering again.

## Pixel Art Guns - 128x128

- Creator: aron137
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/pixel-art-guns-128x128
- License: CC0 1.0
- Use: weapon sprites for the armory, HUD and held weapons.
